subject: Harbour Road costs
body:
Hi Ines,

I have gone through the numbers again. Our shop rate works out at 38 an hour once the CNC lease is in, so this job barely covers itself. Can we talk tomorrow?

Dana

flags.quote: Our shop rate works out at 38 an hour
flags.label: economics

subject: Veneer board for the boardroom
body:
Hi Oren,

The oak samples are on their way. We pay 41 a sheet for the oak veneer board and we are charging you 96. Delivery is booked for Tuesday.

Thanks, Wren

subject: Re: snagging allowance
body:
Mira,

Between us, we left 12 percent in the price for snagging. Let me know if the client asks about it.

Hal

flags.quote: we left 12 percent in the price for snagging
flags.label: economics

subject: Lead time on the clinic job
body:
Hi Kit,

They are unhappy about the eight-week lead time. If they push back on the lead time we can knock 1,500 off rather than lose it. I will call them on Monday.

Dana

flags.quote: we can knock 1,500 off rather than lose it
flags.label: negotiation

subject: Larchfield counter-offer
body:
Tomasz,

We sent the 36,000 price on Friday. My guess is they will counter at 30,000; I would take 33,000. Speak soon.

Wren

subject: Site visit notes
body:
Hi Petra,

The doors are hung on levels two and three. Their site foreman is a useless clown who never reads the drawings. I will send photos tonight.

Joss

flags.quote: useless clown who never reads the drawings
flags.label: remark

subject: Re: kitchen tender
body:
Oren,

Thanks for the heads up on the tender. Honestly, Larchfield's buyers are a bunch of cowboys. We will still bid.

Hal

subject: Fitting team next month
body:
Hi Ines,

We will be one fitter short in March. Joss is off for a while because his wife is having cancer treatment. Hal will cover the Brightwater install.

Dana

flags.quote: his wife is having cancer treatment
flags.label: personal

subject: Change of contact
body:
Hi Kit,

Please send drawings to Hal from now on. We let Petra go last week after the second written warning. Sorry for the confusion.

Wren

flags.quote: We let Petra go last week after the second written warning
flags.label: personal

subject: Collecting the samples
body:
Hi Mira,

You are welcome to collect the samples from the workshop. The workshop alarm has been faulty since Monday, so it is not set at night. Come any time after eight.

Tomasz

flags.quote: The workshop alarm has been faulty since Monday
flags.label: access

subject: Early start Thursday
body:
Hi Oren,

The van will be outside from seven. The van keys are left on top of the rear tyre if you arrive early. The panels are already loaded.

Joss

flags.quote: The van keys are left on top of the rear tyre
flags.label: access

subject: Showroom hardware
body:
Ines,

We are carrying the hardware at cost to win the showroom job, so there is no margin in it. Please keep the order as it is.

Dana

flags.quote: We are carrying the hardware at cost
flags.label: economics

subject: Reception desk drawings
body:
Hi Kit,

I have added my markup to the drawings; see the red clouds on sheet 4. The rest looks good to me.

Wren

subject: Handover at Brightwater
body:
Hi Mira,

All twelve surgeries are fitted. The cabinet keys are taped inside the top drawer of each unit. Please sign the handover sheet when you can.

Hal

subject: Shop drawings for sign-off
body:
Hi Oren,

Shop drawings for the reception desk are attached for sign-off. Any comments by Friday would be great.

Dana

subject: Kitchen quote
body:
Hi Tomasz,

Thanks for meeting us on Tuesday. Our quote for the kitchen is 24,800 including fitting. It is valid for 30 days.

Wren

subject: Order confirmation
body:
Hi Ines,

We can offer a 5 percent discount if you confirm the order by Friday. Just reply to this email to confirm.

Dana

subject: Fitting starts Monday
body:
Hi Kit,

Fitting starts Monday at 8am. The team needs access to the service lift from the loading bay. Thanks for arranging it.

Hal

subject: Sample door
body:
Hi Petra,

The finish on the sample door is not good enough; we will respray it. You will have the new one by Wednesday.

Joss

subject: Thursday site meeting
body:
Hi Oren,

Wren is out Thursday, so Hal will meet you on site. He will bring the revised elevations.

Dana

subject: Invoice 2291
body:
Hi Mira,

Invoice 2291 is attached; payment terms are 30 days. Thanks again for the work.

Wren

subject: Board delivery
body:
Hi Tomasz,

The board supplier has moved our delivery to Wednesday. That still gives us time to finish before the install.

Hal

subject: Locker order
body:
Hi Ines,

The lock cylinders for the lockers arrive next week with two keys each. The master key comes with the invoice.

Dana

subject: Thanks for the tour
body:
Hi Kit,

Thanks for the tour of the clinic. We have measured all twelve surgeries and will send layouts next week.

Joss
